content:
tara: customer reported a transient provisional overage during a canary switch. looks like prefetch + retry -> duplicate provisional ledger writes.
owen: session id?
tara: sess=org-622, trace=trace-a9. happened 2026-03-28T13:05Z. provisional=208 confirmed=104. two provisional events ~180ms apart from different hosts.
rei: sounds like claim race. router grace-window allowed a new owner to emit provisional before the old lease cleared. we need provenance to dedupe.
billing-bot: [alert] provisional-spike org-622 13:05 provisional=208 confirmed=104
owen: short term: hide provisional-only spikes from external alerts and mark as "pending" in UI. product ok with hotfix?
tara: yes, product approved. do hotfix and add a runbook note for oncall.
rei: long-term: add claim_nonce (router generated) + toolcall_id (sidecar/client persisted) to billing events. ingestion should dedupe by (session, claim_nonce) with a Seen cache TTL ~30m.
owen: I'll add /internal/billing/provenance?session=org-622&window=1h endpoint for triage, returning counts grouped by claim_nonce and origin. rate-limited.
rei: SQL snippet for triage:
SELECT claim_nonce, COUNT(*) cnt, SUM(provisional_tokens) p_tokens
FROM provisional_events
WHERE session_id='org-622' AND recorded_at > now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY claim_nonce
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
tara: owners: owen=ingest+endpoint, rei=router+sidecar flag, tara=console+alerts. timeline: hotfix alerting today, router flag canary tomorrow, ingestion dedupe early next week.
billing-bot: [deploy] alerting-hotfix/hide-provisional deployed to canary 14:22 :white_check_mark:
tara: added runbook entry: "provisional spike -> call /internal/billing/provenance -> check duplicate claim_nonce/toolcall_id -> escalate if duplicates present."
rei: good. long term we should avoid tightening grace-window to prevent flapping; prefer idempotency + dedupe.
tara: thanks all. I'll file follow-ups and notify the customer about reconciliation timing.
